name: pricing
title: Pricing
summary: The public pricing page of an AI SaaS product: a monthly/yearly switch with the saving said quietly, plan cards whose prices roll between the two without moving anything, per-seat and usage-based notes ("then $4 per 1,000 credits"), one featured plan, an Enterprise row, a full comparison table with a sticky plan header and a plan picker on phones, and questions in an accordion. Choosing a plan waits on your async callback and says what went wrong if it fails.
